sample_unit: HPB cases discussed at MDT meetings

links.outcome: AI-MDT agreement in complex versus straightforward HPB cases
links.effect: Overall agreement 91.7% (k=0.841); straightforward 96.7% (k=0.938); complex cases dropped to 62.5% (k=0.304; p=0.09), with AI diverging from MDT judgment.
links.quote: Conversely, in complex scenarios agreement dropped significantly to 62.5% (k = 0.304; p = 0.09).

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of Gemini 3.1 Pro LLM treatment recommendations against historical multidisciplinary team decisions for HPB oncology cases.
